title: injaneity/pi-computer-use
claim: pi-computer-use — an extension that lets Pi agents operate real desktop apps on macOS/Windows/Linux: observe a window, find buttons and text, click, type, scroll, and wait for the UI to change.
why_good: The long tail of work lives in apps with no API — legacy ERP, desktop-only vertical tools. Structured control (find controls, act, wait for change) is the sober, reliable version of computer use, and the README is unusually honest about when not to use it — a sign of engineering judgment.
value: desktop RPA rebuilt for agents — sell reliability for GUI-only back-office workflows, a lane where UiPath charges thousands per bot seat and agent-native tooling is still empty.
risk: It's an extension for one niche agent (Pi), and OS vendors plus Anthropic/OpenAI ship first-party computer use; without cross-agent support it stays a plugin, not a product.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product that allows users to control applications on MacOS and Windows, which can be monetized.

zh.claim: injaneity/pi-computer-use —— 让 Pi 在 macOS 和 Windows 上操控你的应用。
zh.why_good: 给 Pi agent 桌面应用的 computer-use 控制(1618★、活跃)——agent 真正干活需要的操作系统自动化层。
zh.value: 按用量/席位卖给自动化桌面流程的团队;切口是可靠的跨应用控制。
zh.risk: Anthropic/OpenAI 的 computer-use 和操作系统厂商都在抢;第三方控制层是在跟巨头硬碰。
